mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain depressed, weekday trip chains shrink and discretionary shopping weakens, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT staying below their last-4-week averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GROCERY_PHARM above its recent norm indicates substitution toward essential trips, which crowds out discretionary retail visits within one to two weeks and pushes RETAIL_REC down.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises at least 5 points above its previous weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 to 14 days after a 5-point or larger jump in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise together, leisure shifts toward home-based and outdoor local activity rather than shopping districts, so retail-and-recreation mobility declines over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both remain above their prior 4-week averages.

mechanism_narrative: A broad fall in TRANSIT together with WORKPLACES signals a tightening or disruption regime that suppresses destination shopping, causing RETAIL_REC to remain below the recent four-week mean over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 5 points below its prior weekly mean and WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points below its prior weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to drop within 14 days after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES cross below their recent means by more than 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in RESIDENTIAL above baseline reflects more time spent near home, which reduces out-of-home retail visits after a short lag and keeps RETAIL_REC below its prior month average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within one week after RESIDENTIAL remains elevated relative to the last 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a leisure-heavy regime, higher PARKS mobility diverts activity away from shopping streets, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the following four weeks rather than strengthening.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above its prior 2-week average by at least 4 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days after PARKS rises by at least 4 points above its recent average.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM rises while TRANSIT falls, households are reallocating trips toward essentials and away from shared mobility, which predicts a further short-run decline in retail and recreation visits.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM is above its recent mean and TRANSIT is below its recent mean.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES rebounds after a low base while TRANSIT stays depressed, the commuting network recovers without a matching return to discretionary travel, so RETAIL_REC will rise over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises at least 8 points from its prior week while TRANSIT remains below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES rebounds by at least 8 points while TRANSIT remains below -15.
